about_the_game:
Why do we have to be restricted by the chess rule of only moving a piece per player turn?

What if we can move pieces in bulk?

The overall time spent per match will be greatly reduced while you can enjoy the thrilled of capturing multiple pieces per turn while defending for own pieces, Might add additional mechanism on top of it. At least add this game to wishlist or bookmark, eh?

All of the graphical assets, visual effects, artificial Intelligent (AI) will be improved in the process of development. Had been spending more than 5 years on making chess . Well, we thought at least make something that can entertain players that know or might not know but will be knowing chess.

Please give some attention to this game, or maybe wishlist it?
